name: The Shattered Hand
summary: Therzok tests rogues in Orgrimmar who seek entry to the secretive Shattered Hand. Their trial sends them after Tazan, a troll smuggler, and his locked satchel.

sections.title: Shadows in the Cleft
sections.body: The Shattered Hand works from the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. The order of assassins and thieves follows old orcish traditions. Warchief Thrall rules the young Horde with honor, diplomacy, and caution, but the Shattered Hand's leaders believe restraint weakens their people. They seek to restore martial supremacy through covert violence, using knives and poison when a battlefield charge may fail.

sections.title: A Smuggler's Fate
sections.body: Therzok tests rogues with a contract to kill Tazan, a troll who operates near Ratchet in the Barrens. Tazan trades with coastal pirates and carries intelligence the guild wants. Recovering his locked satchel proves a rogue can stalk prey beyond the city walls, though opening it calls for further skill.

faq.q: What is the Shattered Hand in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: The Shattered Hand is a covert Horde guild of rogues, scouts, and assassins based in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. Once an old orcish clan known for brutal self-mutilation, it now gathers intelligence and carries out killings, favoring ruthless pragmatism over Thrall's cautious diplomacy.
Therzok is a Shattered Hand handler in the Cleft of Shadow. He tests prospective rogues for the cunning and lethality the guild demands, and openly doubts Thrall's restraint.

faq.q: Why does Therzok want Tazan dead?
faq.answer: Tazan is a troll smuggler trading with the Southsea pirates near Ratchet. He carries information in a satchel that the Shattered Hand wants for its covert work.
Tazan operates in the Barrens, near the coast and pirate activity south of Ratchet.

faq.q: What happens after recovering Tazan's satchel?
faq.answer: Therzok finds the satchel locked when it is returned. Though pleased by Tazan's death, he needs the intelligence inside and makes opening it another test of the rogue's lockpicking skill.

faq.q: Does Thrall know about the Shattered Hand's methods?
faq.answer: The Shattered Hand nominally serves the Horde, but its members work in the shadows and scorn Thrall's cautious leadership. They quietly build intelligence networks and seek to remove threats before the Warchief's diplomacy can delay action.

angles.text: As a Horde rogue, you enter the Shattered Hand through a rite that prizes ruthless efficiency, assassination, and utility over open combat.
As a member of the Horde, you see the Shattered Hand's quiet challenge to Thrall's cautious vision for the young Horde.
